title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC High
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented controls are supported. It explicitly reports conflicting Microsoft availability and licensing guidance, and warns that the general VFAM access controls are unavailable in GCC High rather than presenting them as confirmed GCC High controls.

claims.claim: The general-product user access path is Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone is the documented general-product tenant disable operation.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: The settings page assigns management of web app access to the AI Administrator.
claims.quote:
Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups

Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: The VFAM feature table names Global admin for managing the Viva Insights web app control.
claims.quote: | Viva Insights web app | No | Global admin | Viva Insights |

claims.claim: Turning off the general Viva Insights web app control disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents VFAM access controls, including these access and exclusion policies, as unavailable in GCC-High and DoD.
claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD.

claims.claim: The general web app access control supports individual users and Microsoft Entra ID groups.
claims.quote: You can turn access to the Viva Insights web app on or off for individual users or groups using Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Adding or removing users from web app access takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator does not automatically have web app access and must add themselves.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.quote:
In the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights.
Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API operation for setting the Copilot Dashboard minimum group size was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Dashboard minimum group size PowerShell Microsoft Graph API privacy settings; "minimum group size" "PowerShell" "Viva"; "minimum group size" "Graph" "Copilot". Read settings and privacy-settings; found UI instructions but no setting operation.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator can manage the dashboard minimum group size as described by the settings page.
claims.quote:
Set minimum group size for the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard

Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.claim: The Viva Insights Administrator can manage the dashboard minimum group size.
claims.quote: Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.claim: The dashboard minimum group size defaults to 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The configured minimum group size cannot be lower than five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: The minimum group size determines which groups can receive group-level Adoption and Impact metrics.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set

claims.claim: Tenants with a Viva Insights licence instead use the Viva Insights privacy settings for minimum group size.
claims.quote: Or, if your tenant has a Viva Insights license and you're a Viva Insights Administrator, use these steps to change the minimum group size.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all the settings described on the dashboard settings page.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: Without an exclusion list, dashboard insights include employees with a Copilot licence, Viva Insights licence or manual cohort upload.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights and Viva Insights collaboration behavior reports.

claims.claim: An exclusion list requires its policy to be turned on to take effect.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.claim: The settings page describes managing the unified exclusion list through VFAM or PowerShell.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM.

claims.claim: The unified exclusion list hides specified employees' data from dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: The user exclusion list allows admins to specify which employees' data should not be shown in the dashboard or other Viva Insights reports.

claims.claim: The dashboard settings page itself does not give the exclusion list's navigation path.
claims.quote: Searched: exclusion list navigation within the full manage-settings-copilot-dashboard page. Its exclusion section says to manage it using PowerShell or VFAM and links to feature-access-management; it supplies no navigation steps.

claims.claim: The settings page says the earlier Copilot Dashboard-specific admin center and PowerShell access controls are no longer available.
claims.quote: Previous controls to manage access to the dashboard using the Copilot Dashboard control in the Microsoft 365 admin center or using PowerShell are no longer available.

claims.claim: Previously configured Copilot Dashboard access restrictions now apply to the entire Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: If you previously removed access to the Copilot Dashboard using Copilot Dashboard feature access management control or PowerShell, those configurations now apply to the entire Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: The environment requirements page states a threshold of 50 assigned Viva Insights licences for advanced analysis and the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: At least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are required to access advanced analysis and the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. This minimum threshold can be achieved through a combination of licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot plans include a Viva Insights service plan and advanced analysis for Copilot-licensed employees.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans include a Viva Insights service plan with personal insights as well as manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees with a Copilot license.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard page instead states that 50 assigned Viva Insights licences or one assigned Copilot licence starts data processing.
claims.quote: A minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses, or 1 assigned Copilot license (including the Viva Insights service plan), is required for data processing to kick off.

claims.claim: The Viva service description says the Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Copilot Reporting come with Microsoft 365 Copilot or 10 Insights licences.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Copilot Reporting in Viva Insights comes with Microsoft 365 Copilot or 10 Insights licenses.

claims.claim: The environment requirements page directs readers to their Microsoft account team for pricing rather than supplying a price.
claims.quote: Contact your Microsoft account team for pricing. If you have questions about licensing, have your admin reach out to your Microsoft account team

claims.claim: The pages checked do not document a meter or Copilot Credit charge for using these dashboards.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics GCC High dashboard pricing meter Copilot Credits. Read environment-requirements, supported-environments, license-options, Viva service description and Dashboard passages; credit metrics describe underlying service use, not dashboard charges.

claims.claim: Viva Insights requires applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.
claims.quote: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.

claims.claim: The roadmap description describes reporting and insights, not an agent or an automated action.
claims.quote: analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate

claims.claim: Microsoft warns that recently released capabilities may not yet be reflected in the environments table and recommends checking Message Center and the roadmap.
claims.quote: recently released capabilities might not be immediately reflected in these tables. For the latest product announcements and release information, review applicable Microsoft 365 Message Center posts, the Microsoft 365 Roadmap, and related Microsoft Learn documentation.

claims.claim: Dashboard and analytics experiences serve leaders, analysts and administrators.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in the Viva Insights web app for leaders, managers, and their selected delegates. ... Consumption Dashboard for analysts, managers, and Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The general settings page assigns management of the Agent Dashboard control to the AI Administrator.
claims.quote: Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard ... Applies to: AI Administrator
